initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 69f89876e418aee19a0f4c07df9b7d17504fb10e, whose message says "#8013 made patient 1..1" and whose patch changed the old medicationstatement-spreadsheet.xml row from 0..1 to 1..1. The Jira snapshot also contains a 2015 "done" comment.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and the compatibility map records MedicationStatement.patient=MedicationStatement.subject. Later event-pattern and naming changes preserved the 1..1 cardinality under MedicationStatement.subject; FHIR-38682 later changed the temporary MedicationUsage name back to MedicationStatement. FHIR-41408 and related subject-type work are separate from the FHIR-8013 cardinality decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml definition has MedicationStatement.subject min 1 and max 1, so it already implements the required cardinality.
